name: field
behavior: None — composition wrapper; native labeling semantics (label for/id, description and error wired via aria-describedby; error announced via aria-live or role=alert)

parts.note: stacks label, control-slot, description/error; propagates disabled/invalid/readonly to the hosted control

parts.statesNote: disabled renders in content-disabled per states.md

parts.note: hosts any form control anatomy (input, textarea, select, checkbox, radio-group, switch); no tokens of its own
replaces or follows description when the field is invalid

anatomyNotes: Parts are invariant across themes. Label placement top|left is a THEME capability, not a variant axis: Salt FormField offers labelPlacement top/left/right, shadcn Field offers orientation — placement changes the root's layout RECIPE (stack vs inline grid), never the part list. Interaction states (hover/focus-visible) live on the hosted control, not on the field wrapper.
